payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source, is the book behind the flower, or is there clear evidence it has been moved toward that behind-the-flower depth ordering?
node.criteria: complete: the book is visibly behind the flower in the edited image. partial: the book is not yet behind the flower, but comparison with the source clearly shows it was moved toward the flower in a way that advances the requested relative depth ordering. Do not count mere proximity, displacement without evidence it advances the depth ordering, or unrelated changes to the book or flower. absent: the book is not behind the flower and there is no visible progress toward that depth ordering. unknown: the source-to-edit comparison cannot establish whether the book was moved toward the requested depth ordering.
node.binding: Target: the book; reference: the flower; requested relation: book behind flower, assessed by relative depth ordering and comparison with the source.

outcome.description: Move the book behind the flower, including the requested relative depth ordering.
